title_en: FOR SALE, APARTMENT 2+1+2 IN LAPRAKE, RUGA DRITAN HOXHA
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Dritan Hoxha Street, Laprake! The apartment is organized in 1 distribution corridor, 1 living room together with the kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets and 1 balcony. It is located on the 6th residential floor of a new building (2019) with an elevator. The apartment is fully invested. The area in which it is located offers all the facilities for a comfortable life, being about 5 minutes away from the Black Bird! Orientation of the apartment: North, the price includes a parking lot. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
